```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| eval: false
# Data: https://ourworldindata.org/economic-inequality
income <- readr::read_csv("2025/data/income-share-of-the-richest-1.csv")
plot_data <- income |>
  dplyr::filter(Year >= 1980) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    stringr::str_detect(Country, "(WID)", negate = TRUE),
    Country != "World"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Country = stringr::str_remove(Country, " \\(country\\)")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Continent = countrycode::countrycode(
      sourcevar = Country,
      origin = "country.name",
      destination = "continent"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(Continent == "Europe") |> 
  tidyr::drop_na() |> 
  dplyr::rename(
    Income = `Income share of the richest 1% (before tax) (World Inequality Database)`)
readr::write_csv(plot_data, "2025/data/heatmap_data.csv")
```

```{ojs}
data = FileAttachment("../../data/heatmap_data.csv").csv({typed: true})
```

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  width: 800,
  marks: [
    Plot.rect(data, {
      x: "Year",
      y: "Country",
      fill: "Income",
      tip: {
        format: {
          fill: (d) => `${d}%`,
          x: (d) => `${d}`
        }
      }
    })
  ],
  x: {tickFormat: "", label: null, tickSize: 0},
  y: {label: null, tickSize: 0},
  marginLeft: 120,
  color: {
    scheme: "bupu"
  },
  title: "The share of income received by the richest 1% of the population.",
  subtitle: "Income is measured before payment of taxes and non-pension benefits but after the payment of public and private pensions.",
  caption: "Data: World Inequality Database (WID). Processed by Our World in Data.",
})
```
